pages.text: You've devised a way to forge wolf armor using dark materials. This armor effectively protects your wolf companions, including those you summon, such as Black Wolves and their variants.

You can remove the armor from your wolf using Shears. If the armor is damaged, you can repair it on an Anvil with the metal ingot (either material can be used for repairs), or simply right-click the armored wolf while holding a Cursed Metal Ingot or Dark Metal Ingot—though this will restore less durability.

Additionally, if you are equipped with a Ring of the Forge, the Black Wolf servants you summon may spawn wearing Cursed Metal Wolf Armor. However, armor worn by Black Wolves summoned via a focus cannot be repaired.
